title: Best Pet Stairs 2026: 5 for Senior and Small Dogs
description: Five pet stair sets for beds and sofas: PetSafe Cozy, Pet Gear Easy Step IV, Soothies Portable, Best Pet Supplies Foam and Frisco Wooden — foam vs plastic vs wood, rise per step, and stability.
lede: This guide compares 5 options using published specifications, manufacturer documentation and independent reviews.
methodology: This comparison is desk research. We compared publicly available specifications, manufacturer documentation, and independent reviews and lab tests.

sections.heading: Step rise — the critical measurement
paragraphs: Lower rises (5-6") are easier for short-legged dogs (dachshunds, corgis) and senior dogs with arthritis. Higher rises (7-8") require less floor space but are harder to climb.
Pet Gear Easy Step IV has the lowest 5" rise, the one owners of senior and short-legged dogs report being adopted fastest. PetSafe Cozy has 6" rises. Others are 7-8".

sections.heading: Traction and surface
paragraphs: Carpet-covered (Pet Gear, Frisco Wood) provide best traction — reviews consistently describe dogs stepping straight on.
Foam with smooth covers (PetSafe, Best Pet Supplies) require more confident climbing. Cover with bath mats for older dogs.
Rubber-grip steps are best on hardwood where stairs themselves can slide if dog jumps.

sections.heading: Best for each use
paragraphs: Best for senior/short-legged: Pet Gear Easy Step IV ($70-90). Lowest 5" rise, carpeted, 150 lb.
Best foam: PetSafe Cozy ($50-70). 6" rise, washable cover, 150 lb.
Best travel: Soothies Portable ($35-50). Foldable, 3 lb, 3 steps.
Best mid-tier foam: Best Pet Supplies Foam ($45-75). 4 height options.
Best wood: Frisco Wooden ($50-100). Multi-step versions, best aesthetic.

faqs.q: Do dogs need training to use stairs?
faqs.a: Most figure them out in 1-3 days with treats on each step. Senior/anxious dogs may take 1-2 weeks.
Stairs save space; ramps easier for very arthritic dogs. Most senior dogs prefer low-rise stairs.

faqs.q: What height should pet stairs be?
faqs.a: Top 1-2" below the surface you're accessing. For a 22" bed, want stairs reaching 20-21".

faqs.q: Can large dogs use foam stairs?
faqs.a: Most foam stairs rate to 70-150 lb. Verify capacity. For 80+ lb dogs, wooden or steel stairs are more stable.

petsafe-cozy-pet-steps.review: PetSafe Cozy Pet Steps are the right foam pet stairs for most uses. Memory foam, 6" rise, removable machine-washable cover, supports 150 lb. The 3-step version is appropriate for ~18" beds.

pet-gear-easy-step-iv.review: Pet Gear Easy Step IV is the right pet stairs for senior or short-legged dogs. Lowest 5" rise, carpeted steps, 4 height versions (16-25"), supports 150 lb. Owners of dachshunds and other short-legged seniors report adoption within a day or two.

soothies-portable-pet-stairs.review: Soothies Portable Pet Stairs are the right pick for travel. Foldable (3 lb total), 3 steps, supports 70 lb. Not as comfortable as foam permanent stairs, but portability is right for car trips and vet visits.

best-pet-supplies-foam-pet-steps.review: Best Pet Supplies Foam Pet Steps are a solid mid-tier foam option. Velvet cover (4+ colors), 4 height options (16-25"), supports 100 lb. Velvet is softer than PetSafe's standard fabric.

frisco-wooden-pet-stairs.review: Frisco Wooden Pet Stairs are the right pick for aesthetics or small dogs. Wood with carpeted steps, 2/3/4-step versions, supports 100 lb. Looks like furniture rather than pet equipment.

offerNotes.petsafe-cozy-pet-steps: Available at PetSafe.net, Chewy, Amazon, Target. Replacement covers sold separately.
offerNotes.pet-gear-easy-step-iv: Available at petgearinc.com, Chewy, Amazon. 'IV' = 4-step; II and III also available.
offerNotes.soothies-portable-pet-stairs: Available at Soothies.com and Amazon. 3-step is standard; 2-step also available.
offerNotes.best-pet-supplies-foam-pet-steps: Available at bestpetsupplies.com, Chewy, Amazon. The 3-step at 21" is most popular.
offerNotes.frisco-wooden-pet-stairs: Available at Chewy. 2/3/4 step counts, multiple finishes.

pinDescription: Best pet stairs 2026: PetSafe Cozy vs. Pet Gear Easy Step IV vs. Soothies Portable vs. Best Pet Supplies Foam vs. Frisco Wooden — compared on step height, weight capacity, grip surface and how well each suits senior dogs.

recommendedFor.label: Owners of senior dogs with arthritis or joint pain
recommendedFor.reason: The lowest 5" rise eases each step for arthritic joints, and carpeted treads give hesitant seniors confident footing.

recommendedFor.label: Pet owners who travel frequently with small dogs
recommendedFor.reason: Folds flat at just 3 lb, making it easy to pack for car trips, hotel stays, and vet visits.

recommendedFor.label: Home decor-conscious owners in open-plan living spaces
recommendedFor.reason: Wood construction with a furniture-like finish blends into living rooms where plastic or foam would look out of place.

recommendedFor.label: Pet owners with messy or accident-prone dogs
recommendedFor.reason: The removable machine-washable cover handles accidents and muddy paws without replacing the whole unit.

recommendedFor.label: Budget shoppers wanting color-matched home accessories
recommendedFor.reason: Four color options and soft velvet cover let owners match decor at a mid-tier price with four height choices.
